prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in League City, Texas, and has back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1312; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not give my name on a recording, but I understand the process. You can use the claim file.

Q: That's fine. Can you describe where you were when the collision happened?

A: I was in the parking lot of a shopping center in League City, Texas. I was backing out of a space near the main entrance, going slowly.

Q: What happened next?

A: Another vehicle came down the lane from my right. I didn't see it because my view was blocked by a van parked two spaces over. We hit on the driver's side rear panel.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?

A: Yes, I was.

Q: How fast were you moving at impact?

A: Maybe three or four miles an hour. It wasn't a hard hit, but I felt a jolt in my lower back right away.

Q: Did you seek medical attention?

A: I went to an urgent care clinic that afternoon. They diagnosed a lower back strain and gave me muscle relaxers and told me to rest and avoid heavy lifting.

Q: Are you still experiencing symptoms?

A: Yes. Sitting for long periods is hard, and I've had some stiffness when I get up in the morning. I'm still going to physical therapy twice a week.

Q: Have you had any prior back problems?

A: I had some mild soreness years ago, but nothing that required treatment or time off work.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I want the other driver's insurance to know I'm doing my best to recover and I'd like this resolved fairly.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
